## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- All styling lives exclusively in `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden in HTML.**
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class or ID selectors only.
- HTML must remain clean, semantic, and style-agnostic — restyling the site must require editing only `style.css`, never the markup.

### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store every visual token in `:root` (light default, "Warm Paper") using these **exact names**:

- **Colors (Light — "Warm Paper"):**
  - `--primary: #A83E36` (Rust Red — CTAs, ribbons, highlights)
  - `--secondary: #5B8A72` (Forest Green — accents, badges, focus rings)
  - `--bg-primary: #F3EAD3` (Warm Paper — page background)
  - `--bg-secondary: #EAE0C4` (deeper paper tone — cards and surfaces)
  - `--text-primary: #3E2F26` (Dark Brown)
  - `--text-secondary: #6E5A48` (muted earth brown)
  - `--text-success: #3F6B52` (deepened forest green — must pass AA on light bg)
  - `--text-error: #8C3129` (deepened rust — distinct from `--primary` for clarity)
  - `--border-default: #3E2F26` (used at 2px for the bold print-frame look)
  - `--border-error: #8C3129`, `--border-success: #3F6B52`
  - Extra theme tokens (permitted additions): `--accent-tan: #E8B67C` (Warm Tan — sun disc), `--accent-sand: #D4A574` (Sandy Tan — dunes, secondary surfaces), `--ink: #3E2F26`.
- **Contrast Pairing (mandatory in every theme):** light background tokens pair with dark text tokens; dark background tokens pair with light text tokens. Verify WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1 body, ≥ 3:1 large text) for both themes; if a value fails, adjust its lightness only — never its hue family.
- Never default to pure white; the warm paper tone above is the light background. If a near-white is ever required, use `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff`.
- **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 2px`, `--radius-md: 4px`, `--radius-lg: 8px` (sharp corners suit the print aesthetic — no large radii). `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 rgba(62,47,38,0.25)`, `--shadow-md: 6px 6px 0 rgba(62,47,38,0.3)` — **hard offset "letterpress" shadows only; soft/blurred shadows are forbidden.**
- **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`.
- **Elevation/Stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 1000`, `--z-modal: 1100`, `--z-toast: 1200` (sticky header sits below dropdown, e.g., 900).

### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode ("Starlit Night")
- Dark mode **must** be fully defined under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class:
  - `--bg-primary: #241B15`, `--bg-secondary: #3E2F26`, `--text-primary: #F3EAD3`, `--text-secondary: #CDBB97`, `--primary: #C9584C` (brightened rust for dark-bg contrast), `--secondary: #7FA98F`, `--accent-tan: #E8B67C`, `--border-default: rgba(243,234,211,0.4)`, shadows deepen toward near-black offsets.
- Theme switching must work purely through variable swaps — **no HTML restructuring**.
- **Persistence:** store the choice in `localStorage` (applied as the first action in `script.js`), falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Provide a visible toggle in the header with a Google Material Symbol (`dark_mode`/`light_mode`), correct `aria-pressed`, and `aria-label`.
- The hero landscape illustration must re-skin in dark mode (deep brown night sky, pale moon-like sun) using the same shapes and variables only.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- Build all layout structure with Flexbox.
- **Every flex container must default to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified with a CSS comment (e.g., `stretch` for equal-height cards, `flex-start` for pricing feature lists).
- Mobile-first: single column on small viewports, scaling to multi-column at ≥ 768px and ≥ 1024px. **No horizontal scrolling at any width.** All touch targets ≥ 44×44px.

### 1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration
- Use Tailwind CSS via CDN for **structural utilities only** (display, flex, grid, spacing, widths).
- All visual theming must live in `style.css` as reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`) bound to the CSS variables above.
- **One naming convention: BEM** (`block__element--modifier`) for all custom classes. Never mix conventions.

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- **Text:** Google Fonts via `<link>` — `Abril Fatface` as `--font-display` (vintage poster headlines), `Libre Franklin` as `--font-base` (body), `Bebas Neue` as `--font-accent` (uppercase eyebrow labels, step numerals, ticket-stamp text).
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Rounded set) for every functional UI icon. Raw inline SVGs for UI icons are forbidden.
- **Theme exception (explicit):** decorative landscape illustration layers (sun, mountains, dunes, waves, clouds) may be built with inline SVG shapes and/or CSS `clip-path` per the art direction — this exception applies **only** to non-interactive illustration; all functional icons remain Material Symbols.
- **No external image files or photography.** The entire visual identity is CSS shapes, Material Symbols, and typography. Avatars are initials inside colored circles.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Button Component
- `.btn` base: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px; Bebas Neue uppercase with letter-spacing; 2px solid border; hard offset shadow; `transition: var(--transition-fast)`.
- **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (bg `--primary`, text `--bg-primary`, border `--ink`), `.btn--secondary` (transparent bg, 2px `--text-primary` border), `.btn--danger` (deep rust fill — visually distinct in both themes).
- **Hover:** retro "lift off the paper" — `translate(-2px, -2px)` with the shadow offset growing; `cursor: pointer`. No gradients ever.
- **Focus-visible:** distinct 3px ring using `--secondary` (light) / `--accent-tan` (dark) with 2px offset, for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` with the shadow collapsing to zero offset.
- **Loading (`.is-loading` + `aria-busy="true"`):** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or animated Material Symbol; button dimensions must not change.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale filter, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback state classes with icon + `aria-live` announcement, colored by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.

### 2.2 Card Component
- `.card` base: flex column, `align-items: center` (default), bg `--bg-secondary`, 2px `--border-default`, `--radius-md`, generous padding, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus shadow growth to `--shadow-md`.
- **Focus-within:** border color shifts to `--primary` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (`.card--skeleton`):** shimmer keyframes defined in CSS with stable dimensions — no layout jumps.
- **Empty (`.card--empty`):** structured fallback with a Material Symbol and clear guidance text.

### 2.3 Form & Input Requirements
- `.input-group`: flex column (a commented exception to the center default) wrapping a `<label>`, the input, and a dedicated `.input-group__error` container with `aria-live="polite"`.
- **States:** empty; focused (2px ring in `--primary` plus offset outline); filled; valid (`.is-valid` — success border + check Material Symbol); invalid (`.is-invalid` — error border, error text, error icon); disabled; read-only.
- The newsletter email form (Final CTA and/or footer) must validate in `script.js`, announce errors via `aria-live`, and show a success state with icon + text. **Never rely on color alone** — always icon plus message.

### 2.4 FAQ Accordion (custom widget)
- Trigger is a `<button class="accordion__trigger">` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; panel has `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby`.
- Material Symbol `expand_more` rotates 180° when open; panel height animates via a CSS technique (grid-template-rows or max-height) using `var(--transition-normal)`.
- Fully keyboard operable; visible focus states on triggers.

### 2.5 Modal / Popup (only if a dialog is used, e.g., booking confirmation)
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions.
- Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay `rgba(58, 43, 34, 0.6)`, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` and overlay click, `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`, focus returns to the trigger on close.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES
- **Responsive by default:** fluid typography via `clamp()`, responsive breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal)`; **respect `prefers-reduced-motion`** — disable reveals and transforms, keep instant opacity changes.
- **Vintage reveal system:** `IntersectionObserver` in `script.js` adds `.is-visible`; elements fade in with a slight `translateY(12px)` and staggered delays; hero elements stagger on page load.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in both themes; never color-only state communication; semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`); correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for form errors, loading, and dynamic feedback; include a skip-to-content link.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.

## 4. ART DIRECTION — RETRO TRAVEL POSTER (1930s–60s)
- **Flat, screen-printed look: absolutely no color gradients.**
- **Texture exception (explicit):** one subtle paper-grain overlay is permitted — a fixed, `pointer-events: none` pseudo-element using a repeating dot/noise pattern (CSS pattern or SVG data-URI) at opacity ≤ 0.06; it must read as flat grain, never as a color wash, and must not break contrast.
- Bold 2px Dark Brown borders, hard offset shadows, sharp corners, letter-spaced uppercase Bebas Neue labels, oversized Abril Fatface headlines.
- **Hero landscape:** a layered scene built from CSS `clip-path` polygons and shapes — Warm Paper sky, Warm Tan sun disc, Forest Green and Dark Brown mountain silhouettes, Sandy Tan foreground dunes — stacked with z-index for depth; shapes reveal on load via scale/clip animation.
- **Section dividers:** ticket-edge, zigzag, or wave `clip-path` strips alternating palette colors between sections.
- Dark mode re-skins the same shapes through variables only.
